historical_event: Mentor proposes alternative system architecture combining NiTi wire bundle, positive-pressure confinement, inter-wire jamming, and optional compact SMA syringe/piston pressure source.
claim_or_question: Can the mentor's integrated variable-stiffness architecture serve as a novel, defensible thesis topic?
scientific_interpretation_at_time: The combination of superelastic NiTi wires with positive-pressure jamming and compact SMA actuation was viewed as a potential whole-system novelty candidate.
evidence_available_at_time: Informal mentor proposal; discovery corpus baseline (54 papers).
uncertainties_at_time: Unknown whether individual architecture components or assemblies already exist in literature.
decision_at_time: Do not accept or reject based on intuition; open MP1 as an alternative research direction under adversarial novelty audit while preserving D1/M1 as baseline.
next_action_at_time: Formulate formal claim decomposition and setup verification round MP1-V001.
corrected_interpretation: Component combination does not constitute scientific novelty; broad architecture claims were completely pre-empted by prior art.

historical_event: Decomposition of mentor's architecture into eight distinct, testable claims C1 through C8.
claim_or_question: Are C1 (wire jamming), C2 (positive-pressure jamming), C3 (SMA+jamming), C4 (compact pressure source), C5 (NiTi as jamming medium), C6 (positive pressure on NiTi bundle), C7 (NiTi superelasticity-contact-pressure coupling), and C8 (SMA-driven syringe/piston) individually novel?
scientific_interpretation_at_time: Decomposing the system allows testing whether novelty resides in component principles, material substitution, or coupled mechanics.
evidence_available_at_time: Audit plan and initial search seeds.
uncertainties_at_time: Extant literature on metallic wire jamming, positive-pressure jamming, and SMA-jamming co-integration.
decision_at_time: Execute MP1-V001 core prior-art audit against targeted search results.
next_action_at_time: Ingest papers and construct MP1-V001 verification matrix.
corrected_interpretation: Claims C1–C4 were independently solved prior art; C8 was an implementation substitution.

historical_event: Construction and ingestion of 10-paper full-text verification matrix for MP1-V001.
claim_or_question: Does direct prior art exist for C1–C8 in the assembled literature matrix?
scientific_interpretation_at_time: A 10-paper targeted matrix across wire jamming, positive pressure, SMA integration, and compact pumps is sufficient to test architecture claims.
evidence_available_at_time: 10 full-text papers (Bai 2022, Liu 2021, Zhang & Yao 2026, Takashima lineage, Huynh 2022, Wang 2024, etc.).
uncertainties_at_time: Whether any paper demonstrates superelastic NiTi wires mutually slipping under positive pressure.
decision_at_time: Run automated core prior-art audit runner.
corrected_interpretation: Matrix confirmed fatal pre-emption of architecture novelty.

historical_event: Completion of MP1-V001 audit yielding PIVOT_TO_MECHANICS_CORE.
claim_or_question: Can broad architectural novelty be claimed for MP1?
scientific_interpretation_at_time: C1 (wire jamming), C2 (positive-pressure jamming), C3 (SMA+jamming), and C4 (compact pump) are closed by direct prior art. C8 (SMA syringe/piston) is actuator substitution. Only C5–C7 remain open within the supplied corpus, warranting a pivot to core mechanics.
uncertainties_at_time: Whether existing metallic wire rope or cable mechanics already solves C5–C7 outside the supplied corpus.
decision_at_time: PIVOT_TO_MECHANICS_CORE: Abandon system-level combination claims; narrow MP1 to the mechanics of actively confined NiTi wire bundles.
next_action_at_time: Formulate targeted citation chasing protocol MP1-V002.
corrected_interpretation: C5 (NiTi as slipping medium) was subsequently closed at existence level by wire rope/strand literature in V002.

historical_event: Formulation of MP1-V002 targeted citation chasing protocol with three mechanics targets (T1, T2, T3) and parameter-substitution kill test.
claim_or_question: Does an actively pressure-confined NiTi wire bundle exhibit unique mechanics not predicted by parameter substitution into existing elastic-fiber/cable contact models?
scientific_interpretation_at_time: T1 (NiTi contacting bundle), T2 (active confinement pressure on bundle), and T3 (superelasticity-contact-pressure-hysteresis coupling) form the surviving mechanics question.
evidence_available_at_time: V001 results and targeted search strategy.
uncertainties_at_time: Coverage of specialized wire rope, subsea cable, and NiTi cable literature.
decision_at_time: Execute backward and forward citation chasing anchored on key prior art papers.
corrected_interpretation: Framing T2 as novel mechanics purely because pressure was active was later corrected to an experimental boundary condition.

claim_or_question: Do the initial 8 full-text papers kill targets T1, T2, or T3?
scientific_interpretation_at_time: T1 is closed (NiTi wire ropes and braids with inter-wire contact and friction exist). T3 is substantially pre-empted (coupling between NiTi transformation and friction/hysteresis is established). T2 remains open (no actively varied confinement pressure on NiTi bundle found).
evidence_available_at_time: 8 full-text papers (Carboni 2015, Carboni 2016, Vahidi 2022, Xin Liu 2013, Tjahjanto 2017, Ting-Long 2021, de Paula 2021, Falcetelli 2024).
uncertainties_at_time: Whether parameter substitution of NiTi constitutive laws into elastic contact models explains all observations.
decision_at_time: SUBSTANTIALLY_NARROWED: Maintain focus on actively pressure-controlled bending mechanics.
next_action_at_time: Screen citation metadata for candidate kill papers.
corrected_interpretation: 8-paper matrix was an interim state superseded by 10-paper and 16-paper matrices.

historical_event: Citation metadata screening triages 187 raw records (178 unique), promoting 2 papers directly targeting parameter substitution.
claim_or_question: Are there direct kill papers among citation candidates?
scientific_interpretation_at_time: Zero immediate kill papers identified; 12 papers selected for full-text inspection. Human review selectively promotes Reedlunn et al. 2013 Part II and Fang et al. 2019 to test parameter substitution.
uncertainties_at_time: Content of promoted full-text papers regarding parameter substitution.
decision_at_time: Promote Reedlunn 2013 and Fang 2019 into full-text verification matrix.
next_action_at_time: Ingest promoted papers and re-run threat audit.
corrected_interpretation: Screening successfully avoided bulk retrieval of irrelevant papers.

historical_event: Audit re-run on 10-paper matrix; parameter-substitution test returns inconclusive result.
claim_or_question: Does parameter substitution of NiTi properties into elastic contact models predict bundle bending response?
scientific_interpretation_at_time: Evidence insufficient to conclude that elastic fiber models are sufficient, but also insufficient to claim a distinct constitutive-contact coupling law.
evidence_available_at_time: 10 full-text papers including Reedlunn 2013 and Fang 2019.
uncertainties_at_time: Exact mathematical definition of H0 and identifiability of coupling mechanisms.
decision_at_time: Keep parameter substitution open; prepare detailed mechanics trace packets.
next_action_at_time: Generate Stage 1 mechanics trace packets for adversarial critique.
corrected_interpretation: Binary substitution framing was superseded by 3-tier H0a/H0b/H1 structure in Stage 3.

historical_event: Gemini Flash generates 11 Stage 1 mechanics trace packets (W01–W11) tracing claims against evidence.
claim_or_question: Do the extraction packets rigorously trace the mechanics evidence for all claims and targets?
scientific_interpretation_at_time: Packets documented prior art across NiTi contact, active pressure, parameter substitution, and citation coverage, but contained subtle overclaims.
evidence_available_at_time: Initial trace packets and ingested papers.
uncertainties_at_time: Accuracy of specimen configuration attributions (specifically Carboni 2015 S2a) and rigor of H0 definition.
decision_at_time: Submit trace packets to GPT-5.6 Astra for independent adversarial critique.
corrected_interpretation: Packet W08 contained a critical factual error attributing NiTi transformation to steel rope S2a.

historical_event: GPT-5.6 Astra delivers adversarial scientific critique identifying 12 critical gaps G01–G12.
claim_or_question: Is MP1's surviving mechanics core scientifically defensible and identifiable?
scientific_interpretation_at_time: Astra established that refuting naive elastic substitution (H0a) does not prove H1; existing transformation-aware models (H0b) remain unfalsified; P3 is only a boundary condition; coexistence of slip and transformation is unproven; and macro bending curves suffer parameter compensation.
evidence_available_at_time: Trace packets and primary paper audits.
uncertainties_at_time: Whether MP1 can survive once H0b is treated as the primary scientific baseline.
decision_at_time: Accept all 12 Astra critique points; launch Stage 3 comprehensive remediation.
next_action_at_time: Execute remediation workers W01–W11 and publish 24-chapter report.
corrected_interpretation: Astra's critique was fully validated and led to permanent restructuring of MP1 mechanics core.

historical_event: Evidence matrix expanded to 16 full-text papers at commit HEAD, resolving state ambiguity G11.
claim_or_question: What is the true full-text evidence base for MP1-V002?
scientific_interpretation_at_time: 16 papers fully ingested and audited in TARGETED_THREAT_AUDIT.json, providing full coverage of NiTi cable mechanics, contact formulations, and cable bending baselines.
evidence_available_at_time: 16 full-text papers (Reedlunn I/II, Carboni 2015/2016, Fang 2019, Ting-Long 2021, Falcetelli 2024, Barsi 2025, Kang 2020, Niu 2023, Vahidi 2022, de Paula 2021, Xin Liu 2013, Tjahjanto 2017, Liu 2026, Silva 2022).
uncertainties_at_time: Citation coverage branches B11 and B12 still pending screening.
decision_at_time: Base all Stage 3 remediation analyses on the reconciled 16-paper corpus.
corrected_interpretation: Reconciliation resolved G11 state contradiction permanently.

historical_event: Publication of Stage 3 remediation consensus: 24-chapter evidence report, G01–G12 remediation matrix, and W01–W11 worker reports.
claim_or_question: What is the corrected scientific core of MP1 after resolving Astra critique?
scientific_interpretation_at_time: H0a is REFUTED; H0b is NOT FALSIFIED; H1 has INSUFFICIENT EVIDENCE. P3 is demoted to experimental protocol. Carboni S2a error corrected. Bending stiffness disambiguated into tangent, secant, dynamic. Citation coverage stop condition remains open (B11/B12 pending).
evidence_available_at_time: 16 full-text papers and 11 remediation worker reports.
uncertainties_at_time: Remaining backward citation branches B11 (Kang 2020) and B12 (Barsi 2025).
decision_at_time: Screen B11 and B12 citation branches before proceeding to final adjudication.
corrected_interpretation: Stage 3 statement 'stop_condition_satisfied = false' was subsequently superseded by Stage 4 closure.

historical_event: Completion of Stage 4 citation screening for branches B11 (Kang 2020, 22 records) and B12 (Barsi 2025, 46 records), achieving 15/15 coverage closure.
claim_or_question: Does backward citation screening of B11 and B12 reveal any unconsidered direct prior art?
scientific_interpretation_at_time: Screening of 68 raw records (67 unique) recovered established lineages but no actively pressure-controlled metallic/NiTi bundle bending prior art. Stop condition satisfied.
evidence_available_at_time: 15 screened citation directions (9 backward, 6 forward); search cutoff date 2026-09-25.
uncertainties_at_time: None within the defined protocol boundaries.
decision_at_time: Stop citation chasing; advance MP1-V002 to final adjudication gate.
corrected_interpretation: Closure proved protocol satisfaction, not universal absence of prior art.

historical_event: GPT-6 Sol executes final MP1-V002 adjudication, yielding SURVIVES_TARGETED_CITATION_CHASE.
claim_or_question: What is the final protocol outcome of MP1-V002?
scientific_interpretation_at_time: MP1 survives as a narrow model-discrimination question against H0b for pressure-controlled NiTi bundle bending. Direct kill found = false; confidence = high; topic readiness = READY_FOR_CROSS_DIRECTION_COMPARISON.
evidence_available_at_time: 16 full-text papers, closed 15/15 citation coverage, and Stage 3 remediation deliverables.
uncertainties_at_time: Experimental accessibility of coupled slip-transformation regime; performance relative to D1/M1.
decision_at_time: SURVIVES_TARGETED_CITATION_CHASE: Advance MP1 to cross-direction adjudication with preserved baseline D1/M1.
corrected_interpretation: Survival within protocol qualified MP1 for comparison, but did not automatically make it the chosen thesis topic.

historical_event: Final cross-direction comparison between D1/M1 and MP1 selects D1_M1 under LOCK_WITH_FEASIBILITY_GATE and archives MP1 as a viable alternative.
claim_or_question: Which surviving direction—D1/M1 or MP1—provides the superior scientific, falsifiable, and executable MSc thesis project?
scientific_interpretation_at_time: D1/M1 selected because it evaluates a concrete baseline model (M1), has lower apparatus/diagnostic burden, better parameter identifiability, and delivers high scientific value even from a null result. MP1 suffers from coexistence-domain uncertainty, local measurement difficulty, and high risk of degeneration to H0b.
evidence_available_at_time: Independent falsification records of both D1/M1 (D1-V001 to D1-V009) and MP1 (MP1-V001, MP1-V002).
uncertainties_at_time: Whether D1/M1 will pass its upcoming boundary-resolvability pilot.
decision_at_time: LOCK_WITH_FEASIBILITY_GATE for D1_M1; archive MP1 as viable alternative without scientific disqualification.
next_action_at_time: Update canonical research state and handoff documents.
